agree.reason: The comment accepts the staff's numbers and asks for a specific, modest alternative. A commission that trusts its staff could act on that, but the comment offers no data or help, such as the trip logs or the reporting-app trial, so the request is easy to set aside as one more captain asking for relief.

honest.reason: The comment correctly drops the claim that every boat will close, and its numbers check out. However, "This cut is bigger" compares it to the 2016 cut without knowing how big that cut was, and "it doesn't come back when the stock does" is stated as fact when it is only an assertion.

works_the_facts.reason: The comment works out the $29,000 loss and the 15-trip shortfall. It leaves useful figures unused: 59% of surveyed customers would book fewer trips and only 17% would book the same, about 70% of this season is already booked, and halving charter landings would change the state total by only about 4.5 percentage points.

right_comparison.reason: The comment compares the proposal with real alternatives, a 3-fish limit or a shorter season. It describes the 2016 aftermath as still being 15 trips short and leaves out that bookings were recovering, rising from 138 to 155.

qualification.reason: The comment includes a conditional (two captains will sell if bookings drop as they did in 2016) and a request the commission can check (whether 3 fish or a shorter season meets the target). Neither has a date or a threshold, and nothing says what happens if the condition is not met.

objections.reason: The comment avoids the fight over the science by conceding the stock numbers. It doesn't answer the doubt commissioners will raise, that captains say this at every hearing, and offering the trip logs or the app trial would have answered it. The 9%/80% point invites a reply, because the limit applies to private anglers too.

fit.reason: At about 330 words in plain spoken style, the comment fits a two-minute slot. It still has [NAME]/[HARBOR] placeholders, although the captain's name and boat were known, and a stray closing tag.
